generationDescriptionHint: Describe the topic, learning goals, and what the questions should cover.
generationPasswordHint: Use the shared password provided by the app owner. It is not saved.
generationDocumentHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown. Up to 5 files, 10 MiB each, 20 MiB combined, and 100,000 extracted characters. Scanned and encrypted documents are unsupported.

generationLimitation: AI-generated questions and answers may contain mistakes. Check them against your reference material.

generationCancelHint: Cancelling stops waiting, but an AI request already running may still finish.

generationTemporary: This quiz is available in this tab but could not be saved. Download quiz JSON before refreshing or closing this tab.
generationInvalidInput: Check the title, description, question count, documents, and password, then try again.
generationUnauthorized: The generation password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
generationRateLimited: Too many generation requests. Wait a minute before trying again.
generationRefused: The AI provider could not fulfil this request. Try a different description or reference material.
generationInsufficientMaterial: There is not enough reference material for this quiz. Add detail or request fewer questions.
generationContextLimit: This request exceeds the configured model’s context limit. Reduce the reference material or request fewer questions.
generationInvalidOutput: The AI response did not contain a complete, valid quiz. Try again or request fewer questions.
generationTimeout: The operation took too long. Try fewer questions or smaller reference documents.
generationNetwork: The generation request failed. Check your connection and try again.
generationTooLarge: The documents or request exceed the supported limits. Remove a file or use smaller documents.
generationFileType: Choose PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown files.
generationFileUnreadable: A reference document could not be read. Remove it or choose another file.
generationFileEncrypted: Encrypted reference documents are unsupported. Choose an unencrypted copy.
